description:
Goal
Turn IncomingInputSlot(callee, slot) from nominal vocabulary into the pull dependency for callee input evidence. Transport projection must not reach directly into PullSession incoming maps while pretending the slot is a product.

Signal
A demanded caller records OutgoingInputEdges(E). A callee input transport shape waits on ProductKey::IncomingInputSlot(slot) and receives exactly the sources recorded by demanded callers. Tests prove no scan over all callers or all executables is used to recover incoming input evidence.

Strategy
Route executable-input transport projection through IncomingInputSlot products. Keep OutgoingInputEdges caller-owned. The callee side reads only the slot key. Preserve current 00181 behavior and direct forwarded-input ABI coverage.

Removal target
Remove direct production reads of PullSession::incoming_input_sources from transport/component helpers except inside the IncomingInputSlot producer itself.

Verification
Focused IncomingInputSlot unit test; 00181 product transport test without legacy pre-settle; cargo test -q --lib compiler2_pull_.
title: Pull transport: make IncomingInputSlot a real dependency
